missed_shots_tracker_menu_desc: Change your Shots Missed Tracker settings
missed_shots_tracker_fonts_desc: Font of Shots Missed Tracker text. Font packs need BeardLib.
missed_shots_tracker_font_variant_desc: Small, medium or large variant of the selected font
missed_shots_tracker_text_color_desc: Color of Shots Missed Tracker text. Rainbow cycles through all colors.
missed_shots_tracker_size_desc: Change the size of Shots Missed Tracker text
missed_shots_tracker_table_desc: Show kills and accuracy for each weapon you used
missed_shots_tracker_bg_desc: Show a dark background behind the counter and the table
missed_shots_tracker_counter_desc: Show the total "Shots missed" line above the table
missed_shots_tracker_equipped_desc: Show only the weapon you are holding. Stats of other weapons are kept for when you switch back.
missed_shots_tracker_name_desc: Show the weapon name column in the table
missed_shots_tracker_type_desc: Show type words like Rifle, Shotgun, Sniper, SMG in the weapon name (English names only)
missed_shots_tracker_damage_desc: Show the damage column in the table
